name: SushiSwap
description: SushiSwap is a community-run decentralized exchange that started in 2020 as a fork of Uniswap v2. Today it combines classic and concentrated-liquidity AMM pools with a swap aggregator and cross-chain swaps on dozens of EVM networks, plus perpetuals routed to Hyperliquid; SUSHI is its governance token.
description_zh: SushiSwap 是一个社区运营的去中心化交易所，2020 年作为 Uniswap v2 的分叉起步。如今它在数十个 EVM 网络上结合了经典 AMM 池与集中流动性池、兑换聚合器和跨链兑换，并通过 Hyperliquid 提供永续合约；SUSHI 是其治理代币。

geo_feature.scope: Robinhood stock tokens: US, CA, GB, CH, CU, BY, IR, KP, RU, SY, UA, SS, SD, MM, VE (via /api/geolocation). Perps: Hyperliquid legalCheck (ipAllowed)

screening.provider: TRM Labs public API api.trmlabs.com/public/v1/sanctions/screening; a sanctioned wallet gets disconnected

tos.restricted: 24 named: DZ, BO, BY, Crimea, CU, DPR/LPR, CD, IR, IQ, CI, LR, LY, ML, MM, NP, KP, SO, SD, SY, TN, VE, YE, ZW + sanctioned

notes: Geo checks and screening run in the browser; no backend of their own is involved. Perps use the Hyperliquid API, which checks the IP on its side.
